Kalachakra dasa calculation methods (KalachakraDasaCalculation, dialog 2057 combo 1004; tests/kalachakraOptions.test.ts reads golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/<variant>/). One tab: the Kalachakra maha dasas (full and dates-only copies) and the antardasas of the first three maha dasas. Method 5 is JHora's default (already in the default captures). Run once per variant and restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini afterwards:
  python tools/harness/capture.py --jhora <copy> --views tools/harness/views-dasa-kalachakra.json --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method0 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=0 golden/charts/*.jhd
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method1 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=1
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method2 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=2
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method3 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=3
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method4 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=4
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/method6 --ini KalachakraDasaCalculation=6
  ... --out golden/jhora-dasa-kalachakra/rohini4-cancer --ini KCDRohini4NavamsaInLeo=0
